# Korede R. Bishi

Korede R. Bishi is a Computer Science Ph.D. candidate at the University of Georgia. His research focuses on artificial intelligence, machine learning, validated microscopic traffic simulation, resilient transportation systems, and disaster-response infrastructure analysis.
